backtest.definition: A simulation of a trading strategy against historical market data.

locales.my-MM: နောက်ကြောင်းပြန် စမ်းသပ်မှု
locales.th: แบ็คเทสต์

backtest.notes: Inflect naturally in sentences; the noun also names the historical strategy-testing feature.

balance.definition: The amount of an asset held or available in a venue account.

locales.my-MM: ငွေလက်ကျန်
locales.th: ยอดคงเหลือ

balance.notes: Inflect for number and case; available, used and total balances share this noun.

booking.definition: An internal ledger entry recording an execution, which may lack a witnessed exchange fill.

locales.my-MM: အရောင်းအဝယ်မှတ်တမ်း
locales.th: การบันทึกธุรกรรม

booking.notes: An accounting record, never a reservation. Preserve the distinction between an internal booking and an externally witnessed fill.

cancel.definition: The action that requests cancellation of a trading order.

locales.my-MM: ပယ်ဖျက်
locales.th: ยกเลิก

cancel.notes: The canonical action is cancellation of a trading order. A dialog-dismissal button or task cancellation may require a different native verb; do not force the order verb into those contexts.

cancelled.definition: The status of an order, backtest or process whose cancellation has completed.

locales.my-MM: ပယ်ဖျက်ပြီး
locales.th: ยกเลิกแล้ว

cancelled.notes: Inflect for the item being cancelled. A task or backtest may use a different cancellation verb from a trading order.

desk.definition: A trading team or organizational desk whose members share authorized access in Snapper.

locales.ja: トレーディングデスク
locales.my-MM: ကုန်သွယ်ရေးဒက်စ်
locales.th: โต๊ะซื้อขาย

desk.notes: Inflect for number and case. The shorter desk noun is valid where the trading context is explicit. Do not translate example identifiers such as desk-alpha.

equity.definition: The total marked value of cash and positions in the selected portfolio scope.

locales.my-MM: ပိုင်ဆိုင်မှုတန်ဖိုး
locales.th: มูลค่าพอร์ตสุทธิ

equity.notes: Account or portfolio equity, not equity securities or equal treatment. A shorter same-noun label is valid when the financial context is explicit.

exchange.definition: The exchange on which an instrument is listed or a trade is executed.

locales.my-MM: အိတ်ချိန်း
locales.th: ตลาดซื้อขาย

exchange.notes: The trading institution, not the act of exchanging assets. Keep exchange names and wire identifiers unchanged.

fee.definition: A charge associated with a trade execution.

locales.my-MM: အခကြေးငွေ
locales.th: ค่าธรรมเนียม

fill.definition: An actual execution of all or part of an order, distinct from an internal booking.

locales.my-MM: အော်ဒါအကောင်အထည်ဖော်မှု
locales.th: การจับคู่คำสั่งซื้อขาย

fill.notes: Inflect for number and case. Use the execution sense; never physical filling or a reservation. Filled quantity and order-status labels may use the corresponding verb.

filled.definition: The order status indicating that its entire requested quantity has executed.

locales.th: จับคู่แล้ว

filled.notes: Inflect for gender and number. Quantity columns may use the corresponding noun or participle; only the status denotes complete execution.

funding.definition: Funding payments or accruals associated with an open derivatives position.

locales.th: ค่าฟันดิง

funding.notes: Use the position-funding sense, distinct from depositing funds into an account.

futuresContract.definition: A derivative contract for an underlying asset with a specified expiry.

locales.th: สัญญาฟิวเจอร์ส

futuresContract.notes: Plural and adjectival futures forms are valid in position labels and reconciliation methods.

instrument.definition: A tradable financial instrument identified within an exchange.

locales.my-MM: ကုန်သွယ်ပစ္စည်း
locales.th: ตราสาร

instrument.notes: Inflect for number and case; the shorter instrument noun is valid where the financial qualifier is understood. Instrument identifiers remain unchanged.

leverage.definition: The multiplier relating position exposure to the capital committed.

locales.my-MM: လီဗာရေ့ချ်
locales.th: เลเวอเรจ

limitOrder.definition: An order executable only at its limit price or better.

locales.my-MM: ကန့်သတ်အော်ဒါ
locales.th: คำสั่งจำกัดราคา

limitOrder.notes: Order-type controls may omit the word for order when the field supplies it. Do not apply this term to generic numeric limits or safety caps.

margin.definition: Collateral required or used to support a leveraged trading position.

locales.my-MM: အာမခံငွေ
locales.th: มาร์จิ้น

markPrice.definition: The reference price used to value an open position.

locales.my-MM: ရည်ညွှန်းဈေး
locales.th: ราคาอ้างอิง

markPrice.notes: The short mark label may omit price. Keep the distinction from last price, entry price and execution price.

marketOrder.definition: An order submitted for execution at the available market price.

locales.th: คำสั่งตลาด

marketOrder.notes: Order-type controls may omit the word for order when the field supplies it. Do not apply this term to market data or a trading market.

order.definition: An instruction to buy or sell a specified quantity of an instrument.

locales.th: คำสั่งซื้อขาย

order.notes: Inflect naturally for number, case and agreement. Do not apply to sequence, ordering, sorting or software identifiers.

paperTrading.definition: Simulated trading that does not place live exchange orders.

locales.my-MM: စမ်းသပ်ကုန်သွယ်မှု
locales.th: การซื้อขายจำลอง

paperTrading.notes: Mode labels may use the established short simulated/demo adjective; preserve grammatical agreement with wallet, account or trading.

pnl.definition: Profit and loss for the selected position, portfolio or time window.

locales.my-MM: အမြတ်/အရှုံး
locales.th: กำไร/ขาดทุน

pnl.notes: P&L and PnL are accepted compact forms of the localized profit-and-loss term. Preserve correct expanded wording and local grammatical agreement.

position.definition: An open or recorded holding of a financial instrument.

locales.my-MM: ပိုဇစ်ရှင်
locales.th: สถานะ

position.notes: Inflect for number and case; use the financial holding sense rather than screen location.

realizedPnl.definition: Profit or loss realized through completed executions or closed position quantities.

locales.my-MM: အကောင်အထည်ပေါ်ပြီးသော P&L
locales.th: P&L ที่รับรู้แล้ว

realizedPnl.notes: P&L/PnL may replace the profit-and-loss noun in compact labels. Inflect the realized qualifier naturally; do not confuse realized with executed.

reconciliation.definition: Comparison of Snapper records with authoritative venue evidence to identify mismatches.

locales.my-MM: စာရင်းရှင်းလင်းမှု
locales.th: การกระทบยอด

reconciliation.notes: Matching accounting records against authoritative evidence, not interpersonal reconciliation or trade settlement. Inflect related status and method labels naturally.

signal.definition: A strategy-generated indication to buy, sell or otherwise act on an instrument.

locales.my-MM: အချက်ပြမှု
locales.th: สัญญาณ

signal.notes: A trading signal, distinct from system health or network signaling. Inflect for number and case.

snapshot.definition: A captured state of market or account data at a particular time.

locales.my-MM: အချိန်တစ်ခု၏ ဒေတာမှတ်တမ်း
locales.th: สแนปช็อต

snapshot.notes: A captured data state, not a photograph. Inflect naturally in historical-data and cached-market messages.

spot.definition: The market for direct ownership and exchange of the underlying asset.

locales.my-MM: လက်ငင်း
locales.th: สปอต

spot.notes: Spot trading may qualify a market, venue, account or execution. Keep instrument-kind wire values unchanged.

stopLoss.definition: A protective exit triggered at a specified price to limit a loss.

locales.my-MM: အရှုံးဖြတ်
locales.th: ตัดขาดทุน

stopLoss.notes: SL is an accepted compact label. Inflect the canonical term in price, validation and triggered-event messages.

strategy.definition: A configured trading algorithm that consumes data and produces signals or actions.

locales.my-MM: ဗျူဟာ
locales.th: กลยุทธ์

strategy.notes: Inflect for number and case. Strategy names, identifiers and wire values remain unchanged.

takeProfit.definition: An exit triggered at a specified price to realize a profit.

locales.my-MM: အမြတ်သိမ်း
locales.th: ทำกำไร

takeProfit.notes: TP is an accepted compact label. Inflect the canonical term in price and validation messages.

trailingStop.definition: A protective stop whose trigger follows favorable price movement by a defined distance.

locales.ja: トレーリングストップ
locales.my-MM: နောက်လိုက်ရပ်
locales.th: Trailing stop

trailingStop.notes: TS is an accepted compact label. Inflect naturally in attach, confirmation and activation messages.

unrealizedPnl.definition: The marked profit or loss on position quantities that remain open.

locales.my-MM: အကောင်အထည်မပေါ်သေးသော P&L
locales.th: P&L ที่ยังไม่รับรู้

unrealizedPnl.notes: P&L/PnL may replace the profit-and-loss noun in compact labels. Inflect the unrealized qualifier naturally; do not confuse unrealized with unexecuted.

venue.definition: An external trading venue whose account state supplies authoritative balances and positions.

locales.ja: 取引プラットフォーム
locales.my-MM: ကုန်သွယ်ရေးပလက်ဖောင်း
locales.th: แพลตฟอร์มซื้อขาย

venue.notes: The platform where the user's account lives: an exchange or a broker. Always use a term distinct from exchange; keep exchange wording where the English source says exchange.

wallet.definition: A Snapper trading scope that groups funds, positions and associated activity.

locales.my-MM: ဝေါလက်
locales.th: กระเป๋าเงิน

wallet.notes: Inflect for number and case. Keep distinct from a portfolio where the source names both concepts.
